question:
Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

A sits fourth from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between A and B. Only three people sit between C and B. E sits third to the left of C. D sits second to the right of G.

How many people sit between A and F?
